entities.summary: Yunan Tombe Trille Kuku Andali is a Sudanese prelate of the Catholic Church who is the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of El Obeid, in Sudan since 13 February 2017. Before then, from 7 April 1991 until he was appointed bishop, he was a priest of the same Catholic diocese. He was appointed bishop by Pope Francis. He was consecrated bishop on 23 April 2017.
